sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: On-Site Factory Pre-Shipment Quality Control and Audit Agency

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act CAP 222 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act CAP 246 (as amended); Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Regulations; Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2021 (VFSC Directive BO-2021)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport page (principal shareholder/director/UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the individual's country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of utility bill or bank statement for proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or bank in the individual's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if non-Hague issuer)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (financial standing and character)
Certificate of Incorporation and good standing of corporate shareholder (if entity owner)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and due diligence questionnaire (signed by each UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant/UBO under oath before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if non-Hague)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and signatories are screened at onset and on refresh against OFAC SDN list, UN Consolidated Sanctions list, EU consolidated sanctions list, UK HMT sanctions list, and VFSC's own adverse-media/regulatory-action database. Designated PEPs from high-risk jurisdictions are subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD), source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval. Negative hits or ambiguous matches trigger SAR filing with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) and escalation to the AML/CFT compliance officer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online company registry (via www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The International Companies Act requires company names to be in English and/or French using Latin alphabet characters only. Non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into English and the transliteration must be stated; any name likely to mislead as to identity or imply official or governmental patronage is refused. The name may not be identical or too closely resemble a name already registered in the VFSC name register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where the VFSC rejects a proposed name, the applicant (typically through a licensed registered agent) may submit a written appeal to the Registrar within 15 working days of rejection, specifying why the name complies with statutory purity and availability rules. An extension of reservation may be requested before expiration for up to 30 additional days by filing Form NC-Ext and paying an extension fee. Unresolved appeals may be escalated to the Financial Services Tribunal or the Minister of Finance and Economic Management for final administrative review within 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Licensed registered agents may provide virtual/registered office services for an International Company; no physical lease is required for offshore inspection-service company. However, the registered office must be a real, physical address in Vanuatu (the agent's office) at which legal process can be served and official communications received; purely virtual/PO Box ONLY is not permitted for statutory service.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (less than 2% per year). VFSC and VFIU conduct targeted, unannounced inspections of registered agents rather than of each underlying IC. But on-site inspections may occur if adverse intelligence or sanctions/AML flags arise, or if the agent is audited.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Vanuatu), ss. 5 (method of incorporation), 10 (certificate of incorporation), 12 (constitution), and 13 (registered office and registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-01) submitted through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, followed by issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; at least one subscriber share may be issued, and payment for issued shares may be deferred to the extent permitted by the company's articles
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company subscribe to the Memorandum and Articles of Association presented to the Board and approve the filing of the International Company Incorporation Application with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby established at Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that the licensed registered agent be appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the proposed directors and corporate secretary are appointed with full powers to execute the Certificate of Incorporation, issue subscriber shares, open bank accounts, and obtain all operational licenses required for commercial inspection and testing activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through approved Registered Agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a registered agent authorized by the VFSC and provide the proposed corporate name in English for availability screening. The agent performs the name search and submits the reservation request electronically to the VFSC International Companies Registry.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and three alternatives
Identity and nationality details of proposed shareholders
Consent to act as registered agent from the VFSC-licensed agent
Brief description of intended inspection and testing business activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused or reserved by another entity, the agent files a fresh application with alternative names without additional statutory penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in accordance with the International Companies Act. Execute the documents before a notary public or authorized official in Vanuatu or the subscriber's jurisdiction, with witnessed signatures of all initial shareholders and proposed directors.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber declaration and registered office consent
Directors' and secretary's consent to act
Certified copy of passport or valid government identification for each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registry issues a query notice listing formal defects; the registered agent resubmits corrected, notarized documents within 7 calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Incorporation Application and Pay Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-01 together with the constitutional documents and statutory incorporation fee. Payment is made by wire transfer or direct deposit to the VFSC official account. The application must state the International Company's name, registered office address, registered agent, and authorized capital structure.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent certification
Evidence of payment of filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incomplete information, the agent files a response with the requested declarations within 14 days; non-response leads to deemed withdrawal, and the application may be refiled.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Certificate of Incorporation and Issue Subscriber Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and the Company's Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated on the approval day. The board then adopts the share register, records subscriber share allocations, and issues share certificates as authorized by the First Board Resolution.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Share register and share certificates
First Board Resolution and minutes
Registered agent confirmation of receipt of certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, a formal written request for rectification is submitted to the VFSC, which issues an amended certificate within a further 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Corporate Bank Account with Proof of Legal Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking institutions in Vanuatu and VFSC supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, First Board Resolution, and valid identification of directors and signatories to a licensed commercial bank. Complete the bank's client onboarding and anti-money laundering questionnaire, naming Wire Transfer and Wise as approved outgoing payment rails.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
First Board Resolution authorizing bank account
Passport copies and proof of address for signatories
Corporate structure chart and ultimate beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires further beneficial ownership details, provide a notarized declaration and, if necessary, a legal opinion confirming the International Company's lawful formation and tax-exempt status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Business License and Operational Permits for Inspection Activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the business licence application with VIPA for the category of professional, scientific, and technical services. Attach the incorporation documents, local premises lease or registered office address, proposed operational plan for on-site factory pre-shipment inspection, and evidence of insurance coverage.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Business licence application form
Lease agreement or premises title
Operational plan and staffing schedule
Professional indemnity or public liability insurance certificate
Fire and safety clearance where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VIPA raises a zoning or licensing query, submit amended premises documents or a revised operational plan within 14 days; an internal review is conducted by the business licence officer before final determination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives – Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 204] for 'On-Site Factory Pre-Shipment Quality Control, Inspection and Technical Testing Services'

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration with initial environmental screening; Category B activity not requiring a full EIA report where the licensed operation is low-impact, premises-limited, and generates no significant industrial emissions
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Vanuatu National Effluent Standards (pH 6-9, BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L), occupational VOC exposure limits under the Vanuatu Occupational Health and Safety framework, and waste handling manifests for laboratory reagents or testing residues

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Police Fire and Rescue Service, structural load inspection approval from the Public Works Department for occupied premises, and workplace health clearance from the Department of Labour for personnel conducting on-site client factory audits

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal and e-services: www.dcir.gov.vu; corporate registry and IC licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — Incorporate International Company (IC) with VFSC and obtain Certificate of Incorporation; IC is statutorily exempt from all income, withholding, capital gains, and stamp taxes. Step 2 — Determine if the IC makes taxable supplies within Vanuatu: if annual taxable turnover of local supplies exceeds VT 10,000,000, apply to DCIR for VAT registration on Form VAT-01 with incorporation certificate, business license, director/beneficial owner identification, and declared local business premises. Step 3 — For a purely offshore service model (non-resident clients, no local supplies), no VAT/TIN registration is statutorily required; a Certificate of Incorporation plus VFSC Good Standing certificate serves as tax identity for banking and counterparty due diligence. Step 4 — Issue invoices referencing the IC registration number; no separate tax file number (TFN/TIN) is issued if no VAT registration is triggered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: International Companies are exempt from income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax; no Tax_Exempt_Zone certificate required — statutory exemption under Companies and International Business Companies Act 2012; VAT is the only material indirect tax and applies only on Vanuatu-sourced taxable supplies above the registration threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election regime exists in Vanuatu. No hybrid mismatch or look-through elections apply because the IC is not subject to income tax at any jurisdictional level. Voluntary VAT registration below the VT 10,000,000 threshold is available at the taxpayer's option, and a VAT registration can be cancelled if taxable supplies cease or fall permanently below the threshold; no other classification elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Value Added Tax Act [CAP 296]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover of supplies made within Vanuatu (approximately USD 83,000); foreign-sourced offshore service fees from non-resident principals do not count toward the threshold, and zero-rated export supplies are excluded from the threshold computation
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, mandatory API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime is in force in Vanuatu as of the current effective date. VAT registered entities must issue sequential tax invoices containing full seller/buyer identification, tax invoice number, date, description, quantity, price, VAT amount, and the words 'Tax Invoice'. Paper, PDF, and standard accounting software invoices are acceptable; DCIR retains audit rights to require electronic submission of invoice data upon inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available under the VAT Act where the supplier is a VAT registered person and (a) the goods are exported from Vanuatu in accordance with Customs export procedures, or (b) the services are supplied to a person who is not resident in Vanuatu and are performed wholly or principally outside Vanuatu, or (c) the services are directly related to exported goods. Pre-shipment factory inspection, testing, and quality control services performed in a foreign country (e.g., at client factories in China, India, or Vietnam) for offshore principals qualify for zero rating, subject to contemporaneously documented supply contracts, inspection reports, and foreign-invoice evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Entry Number) for any physical goods, samples, or calibration equipment temporarily exported
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical movement of goods out of Vanuatu (where applicable)
Service Agreement / Inspection & Testing Contract with the non-resident client specifying offshore performance
Detailed Inspection Report / Test Certificate / Quality Audit Report identifying the foreign manufacturing site
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT advice) or interbank transfer evidence showing foreign-source payment received by the IC
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR audit triggers include invalid zero-rating documentation, unsupported invoices, and mismatched foreign remittance records. Penalties under the VAT Act [CAP 296]: late payment penalty of 50% of the unpaid tax, additional 25% penalty where tax remains unpaid more than 30 days after demand, and monthly interest at 1.5% on arrears; mis-declaring output tax as zero rated to obtain a tax benefit constitutes a serious offence punishable by fines up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 3 years. The Commissioner can issue retrospective assessments within 5 years of the relevant supply and claw back credited input VAT with penalty and interest on a joint and several basis for officers of the IC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains an open, freely convertible current account without exchange control legislation. Payments and transfers for current international transactions are unrestricted, and the Vatu (VUV) is convertible via authorised commercial banks. Capital account transactions are equally open: foreign investors and International Companies may inject capital and repatriate profits, dividends, and loan service payments without prior RBV approval. The only practical compliance hurdles are anti-money laundering due diligence expectations at the commercial bank level and correspondent bank screening for USD clearing. Profit remittances are not subject to a statutory tax or additional permit, provided the underlying source of funds is verified and appropriate supporting documentation is presented.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory export proceeds surrender requirement in Vanuatu. No statutory timeline exists for repatriation of export receipts, and there is no prescribed conversion ratio into VUV. Exporters and service providers, including inspection and testing agencies, may retain proceeds in foreign currency accounts at domestic commercial banks or convert to VUV at prevailing market rates as operational preference dictates.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV/USD) and Foreign Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV/USD) and Settlement Account for Trade Transactions
Operational Account / Foreign Currency Account and Escrow-Oriented Deposits

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low–Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms do not hold any Vanuatu banking licence and cannot access the VUV clearing or RBV settlement infrastructure. The VFSC does not maintain an electronic-money institution licensing category; an offshore EMI operating without a local banking licence would likely breach the Financial Transactions Reporting Act or the Banks Act if it held client funds locally. An EMI may be used as a secondary USD/EUR corridor for trade disbursements, but it cannot serve as the primary treasury rail because it lacks Vanuatu IBAN/VUV capability and presents elevated correspondent de-risking risk. Vanuatu-registered International Companies should therefore use a tier-1 commercial bank as the base clearing nexus.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of all directors is not an absolute statutory rule. However, Vanuatu AML/CFT regulations require banks to obtain reliable, independent verification of every client. In practice, at least one director or a duly authorised senior signatory must attend an in-person interview at the Port Vila or Luganville branch of the chosen bank as part of the initial account opening. A hybrid onboarding route is permitted by certain banks: notarised and apostilled corporate documents, a video-identified director, a reference from a licensed registered agent, and a source-of-wealth declaration may substitute for full physical board attendance. The final credit and compliance decision remains with the bank's Money Laundering Reporting Officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) appears on sanctions lists or is resident in a high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current passport and residence permit (notarised); utility bill dated within 3 months; independent bank reference letter; professional CV and source-of-wealth statement; enhanced sanctions screening explanation; legal opinion confirming clear commercial rationale; undertaking to provide quarterly transaction statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure involves bearer shares, nominee shareholders, or an opaque trust layer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the International Company register of directors and shareholders; certified trust deed and declaration of trust identifying every natural-person beneficiary; written legal opinion from a Vanuatu-licensed agent; VFSC good standing certificate; sworn declaration of beneficial ownership; commitment to notify the bank of any structural change within 14 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected transaction pattern is inconsistent with a factory inspection and quality-control agency profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master services agreements with overseas manufacturers or importers; pro-forma invoices and actual commercial invoices for inspection services; purchase orders confirming buyer-seller relationship; sample inspection reports and photographic evidence; quality control certificates; LC and SWIFT messages evidencing genuine trade; forecast and historical cash flows; audit trail of job numbers and staff allocation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of injection capital is an obscure private company or mixed third-party funding account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract of the funding entity's trade registry; corporate ownership chart; board resolution authorising the transfer; source of funds letter from the remitting bank; copy of the share subscription agreement or shareholder loan agreement; audited financial statements of the ultimate parent; declaration that funds are not connected to illegal activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Directors or signatories cannot provide independent proof of residential address or business availability
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised passport scan; international bank reference letter; government-issued identity card; lease agreement or ownership title for residence; payroll or tax return record; video interview transcript; sworn affidavit confirming residential status in the country of residence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are cleared through the Vanuatu commercial bank's correspondent network, typically in USD via major US clearing banks. The routing protocol requires the remitter to use SWIFT MT103 with a precise purpose narrative, for example 'Equity Capital Injection for International Company VU_IC – ISIC 7120 Inspection Services' or 'Shareholder Loan for Working Capital – Factory Inspection Agency'. The bank will verify the beneficiary name against the VFSC certificate of incorporation and the registered agent's records. Before settlement, the client must provide an account-opening letter, a board resolution authorising the account, a copy of the inward remittance advice, and a breakdown of the capital injection. Amounts above VUV 5,000,000 or USD 50,000 trigger enhanced due diligence, including a source-of-funds questionnaire. The bank may obtain the SWIFT GPI tracking reference and screen all parties against UN, OFAC, or EU sanctions lists.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements from the inspection and quality-control entity are routed through SWIFT MT103 for fee settlements to overseas calibration laboratories, technical consultants, and trade settlement counterparties. For larger transactional activity, a Commercial Letter of Credit (documentary LC) can be opened via the Vanuatu bank and issued through its correspondent banker. The preferred clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 because it is efficient for service-based fees; an irrevocable documentary LC is used only when the inspection agency is effecting payment for verified physical goods, and it must be supported by shipping documents, inspection certificates, and a conformity assessment report. For smaller operational expenses under USD 10,000, the bank may permit batch processing or transfer through a designated settlement platform such as Wise, but the bank remains the sole regulated gateway for foreign exchange conversion and compliance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV deliverable FX forward contracts with an authorised Vanuatu commercial bank
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on VUV, cash-settled in USD with an internationally recognised counterparty
Cross-currency swap agreements between USD and VUV entered into with an authorised dealer or an OECD-based swap counterparty
Plain vanilla EUR/USD and AUD/USD FX forwards where the inspection agency's contracts are denominated in those currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return under International Companies Act [Cap 222], s.82
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; annual government renewal fee payable by 30 June of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 25,000 (approx. USD 200); continued default beyond 6 months after the deadline authorizes the Registrar to issue a 30-day strike-off notice; administrative strike-off and dissolution follow under Cap 222, s.142, with assets vesting in the Government and restoration available only by court order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the licensed registered agent of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, filed concurrently with the Annual Return; share transfer updates must be submitted to the agent within 14 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Knowingly submitting a false or incomplete UBO confirmation is a criminal offence; persistent non-confirmation may lead to agent resignation, referral to VFSC, and administrative strike-off with director disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Continuation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent acting as statutory officer of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 June; agent termination requires simultaneous replacement to remain in good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and agent in Vanuatu is a continuing breach; the agent must notify VFSC upon resignation, and the Registrar may strike off the company if no replacement is appointed within 90 days.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandated for a non-licensed Vanuatu International Company solely on grounds of turnover, assets, or employees. A compulsory independent audit arises only where (i) the company holds a VFSC-regulated licence (banking, insurance, securities, or fiduciary); (ii) the company's articles of association require an audit or review; or (iii) shareholders holding at least 10% of the voting shares deliver a written demand for an audited financial statement. A commercial inspection/testing entity holding a VFSC service-provider licence may therefore be subject to licensed-entity audit conditions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for statutory and audited financial statements; non-licensed International Companies may maintain books under any recognized accounting framework (IFRS, UK GAAP, or US GAAP) that gives a fair and accurate view of financial position; local VFSC guidance requires underlying accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and enable preparation of IFRS-compliant statements on demand.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and transmit to VFSC an annual confirmation listing all current beneficial owners as of the filing date. Any share transfer during the year must be recorded in the company's beneficial ownership register within 14 days and reflected in the next annual confirmation; supporting evidence (executed share transfer form, board resolution, updated share certificate) must be retained at the registered office for inspection. Changes in ultimate ownership triggered by indirect trust or corporate restructurings are equally reportable at the annual confirmation stage.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; an International Company (VU_IC) is expressly exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, fees and levies on income, assets, transactions and operations under section 92 of the International Companies Act [Cap.222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for all ICs. No payroll tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, no dividend tax, and no social security levy on employer (voluntary VNPF participation only). Export of inspection/testing/QC services to non-resident clients is zero-rated for VAT, producing a full input-VAT refund position.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The mandatory annual filing is the VFSC Annual Return and Licence Renewal (IC-AR) submitted electronically via the licensed Vanuatu registered agent using the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation; a 30-day grace period is conventionally observed before late-renewal surcharges commence. There is no fiscal-year-end reconciliation because no CIT base exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the IC and its certificate reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; non-resident shareholder identity may be withheld from the public register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office maintained by the licensed agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a street address in Port Vila supplied by the agent; a PO Box is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the IC's statutory point of service; change of agent must be filed within 14 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, addresses, and identification particulars of all directors and members
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee arrangements are lawful; the true beneficial owner must be separately disclosed to VFSC on the confidential Beneficial Ownership Register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital denomination and aggregate of shares issued
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital applies; the annual government fee escalates with authorised capital bands, so capital should be kept at the minimum band for SGD-substrate fee efficiency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not held any land, and has not maintained a physical presence in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All inspection/testing fees must be earned outside Vanuatu; any local activity voids the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prescribed annual licence fee based on authorised capital (minimum band approximately USD 350)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payable through the registered agent on or before the anniversary date; non-payment triggers striking-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal surcharge of 10% of the annual fee per month of arrears; automatic striking-off or dissolution after three months of default; reinstatement fee equal to all arrears plus a restoration fee; trading while struck off is an offence punishable by a fine up to VT 500,000 and/or 12 months imprisonment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Value Added Tax Act [Cap.253]) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VIR) portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; quarterly filing may be approved by the Commissioner for small taxpayers
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due by the 25th day of the month immediately following the reporting period

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Total value of taxable supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of standard-rated (12.5%) and zero-rated supplies made during the period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export QC, inspection, and testing fees invoiced to foreign principals are zero-rated; retain inspection reports and contracts as export evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged on standard-rated local supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero where no Vanuatu-resident supply is made; foreign-currency invoices are not subject to Vanuatu VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on purchases and imports used for the taxable business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Vanuatu VAT invoices support claims; foreign supplier invoices without VIR VAT are irrecoverable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT less input VAT; excess input tax gives rise to a refund or carry-forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-rated exporters are normally in a refund position; claims are subject to documentary audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Mandatory registration when annual taxable turnover reaches VT 5,000,000; late filing fixed penalty of VT 10,000 per return; late payment surcharge of 3% per month on the outstanding amount; evasion penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded, plus criminal prosecution of responsible officers.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no withholding tax is imposed on dividends declared by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders, irrespective of the shareholder's residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-taxation treaty network; only a limited network of Tax Information Exchange Agreements (notably with Nordic states) is in force. No Treaty Resident Certificate or DTA relief procedure exists. In place of a TRC, the registered agent may obtain from VFSC a Certificate of Tax-Exempt Status confirming the IC's exemption. Foreign shareholders must rely on their domestic law for any credit, and foreign tax authorities may independently request the VFSC information exchange channel.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 0%. There are no treaty rates because no DTA applies. The VU_IC may therefore remit management fees, IP royalties, and intercompany loan interest to its foreign parent without any Vanuatu leakage.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File / Master File thresholds, no APA regime, and no vatu-denominated documentation requirement because no income tax base exists.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: No statutory methodology codified; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines used defensively where a foreign jurisdiction asserts a TP adjustment
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations apply; pure ICs face no local substantive quota, headcount, or expenditure thresholds. VFSC nevertheless requires a licensed registered agent, registered office, statutory registers, and a compliant Beneficial Ownership Register. Where the IC invoices factory-inspection work performed in the United States, China, or the EU, foreign CFC / anti-conduit / permanent-establishment rules may recharacterise the structure; the inspection contracts, pricing policies, and management decisions must therefore evidence real offshore commercial substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the VU_IC as a paper billing shell for inspection teams physically working in high-tax jurisdictions, with fabricated cost-plus margins and no commercial purpose other than the avoidance of foreign corporate income tax and payroll liabilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No domestic Vanuatu income-tax sanction exists; however, VFSC may strike off the IC for false declarations, and Vanuatu may exchange information under its TIEAs. The foreign jurisdiction may impose CFC attribution, permanent-establishment reclassification, withholding assessments, and penalties up to 100% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false 'no local business' declarations face fines up to VT 500,000 and/or 12 months imprisonment; under the Proceeds of Crime Act, courts may issue restraint orders, travel bans, and confiscation orders over directors' assets connected to fraudulent conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Performing inspection/testing services in or for Vanuatu residents, leasing or holding land in Vanuatu, opening a physical operating office in Port Vila, or employing Vanuatu nationals without converting the entity to a domestic company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate loss of the section 92 tax exemption; retroactive assessment of all Vanuatu taxes and duties including VAT on local supplies; forced deregistration; and a fine not exceeding VT 1,000,000 under the International Companies Act for conducting prohibited local business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally and jointly liable for debts and distributions arising from the prohibited local business; the Registrar may disqualify them from acting as directors of any Vanuatu company for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file, update within 30 days, or verify the Beneficial Ownership Register with VFSC; concealing the ultimate shareholder behind a straw nominee without a compliant legal arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalty up to VT 5,000,000 on the IC, plus daily default fines of VT 10,000 per day; repeated non-compliance results in automatic dissolution and VFSC information-sharing with foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers face fines up to VT 2,000,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years for knowingly submitting false beneficial-ownership particulars; travel bans may be imposed during AML investigations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exceeding the VT 5,000,000 turnover threshold without VAT registration; falsely zero-rating inspection services actually enjoyed by Vanuatu-resident clients; fabricating export evidence to support input-VAT refund claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Evasion penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded; interest at 3% per month on arrears; refund clawback; criminal fine up to VT 1,000,000 or imprisonment up to 7 years for intentional fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Commissioner may disregard the corporate façade and recover unpaid VAT directly from directors; directors who sign fraudulent VAT returns face criminal prosecution and confiscation of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell status and economic substance attack abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC with no substantive operational records — no bank account in the IC name, no inspection contracts, no audit trail of delegated field work, and sole reliance on pass-through billing of foreign agency commissions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No domestic Vanuatu penalty; the source jurisdiction may recharacterise the IC as fiscally transparent, apply transfer-pricing adjustments with penalty rates up to 40%, and list the entity for enhanced scrutiny in foreign tax-risk registries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign courts may treat the directors as de facto directors of a phantom company and hold them personally liable for unpaid corporate taxes; entry bans and extradition exposure arise where withheld employee taxes or social contributions were diverted through the structure.
